statements.status_notes: GO-2026-5932 is scoped exclusively to the deprecated golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp package tree (and subpackages), which is frozen upstream with no fixed module release. Scout matches golang.org/x/crypto at the module level because the advisory records the module with no fixed version. The dhi-kserve APK ships manager, agent, router, localmodel, and localmodelnode binaries built from kserve v0.20; none of these binaries import or link golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp, so the vulnerable OpenPGP code is not present in the shipped artifacts (vulnerable_code_not_present).

This DHI package backports the upstream fix from systemd v258.9 (commit a8feb2f23565d39df5c90a753c851c1934a53117) before building. The patch rejects non-normalized cgroup paths in the systemd-oomd ManagedOOM varlink handler, closing the path traversal that allowed local users to terminate arbitrary processes.

CVE-2026-56392 is an integer overflow in unexpand buffer allocation that multiplies max_column_width by MB_LEN_MAX. That allocation path was introduced after coreutils 9.7 (multibyte expand/unexpand support; first present in 9.11). Debian trixie and this DHI package ship 9.7, which still allocates with ximalloc(max_column_width) and does not contain the vulnerable multiply.
The DHI coreutils package backports the upstream uniq -w multibyte find_field() fix from commit d64e35a8a4c0e4608321433e0d84d917e4e36371.

The DHI gawk package backports the upstream readdir ftype path-length fix from https://cgit.git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/gawk.git/commit/?id=cca0366144336b49aaa7d5d949966ce8e2c70843 as dhi-cve-2026-40553-readdir-ftype-overflow.patch, adapted to replace 5.2.1 strcpy/strcat path construction with snprintf and a truncation check before stat().

The DHI gawk package backports the upstream do_sub replacement-expansion overflow check from https://cgit.git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/gawk.git/commit/?id=aa7272a6e1184cdd21ab8f89200219abd8053eda as dhi-cve-2026-40469-do-sub-repl-overflow.patch, which performs the ampersand length math in 64-bit and fatals before heap corruption on overflow.

The DHI gawk package backports the upstream integer-overflow hardenings from https://cgit.git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/gawk.git/commit/?id=062f2f2581b991362c046f7f2e238ffa34e6f8c7 as dhi-cve-2026-40468-do-sub-sofar-overflow.patch, which types do_sub sofar as size_t and widens parse_escape's accumulator to int64_t.

The DHI gawk package backports the upstream do_getline_redir DEREF ordering fix from https://cgit.git.savannah.gnu.org/cgit/gawk.git/commit/?id=a2d18c74109e41bec29a23098eba2e00057286d8 as dhi-cve-2026-40467-getline-redir-uaf.patch, which keeps redir_exp alive until after is_non_fatal_redirect() so the two-way pipe NONFATAL path cannot read freed memory.
